title: Right Ventricular Dysfunction in Cardiac Surgery Patients
brief_summary: To establish the correlation between echocardiographic parameters of the RV, measured with TEE and the right ventricular ejection fraction (thermodilution). To identify a time in the perioperative process when RV dysfunction occurs.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* cardiac surgery patients
* elective, isolated aortic valve replacement or coronary artery bypass grafting in combination with aortic valve replacement

Exclusion Criteria:

* age \< 18
study_population: 15 cardiac surgery patients (elective, isolated aortic valve replacement or coronary artery bypass grafting in combination with aortic valve replacement) with a significant preoperative aortic valve stenosis (gradient\>40mmHg and/or aortic valve area \<1cm2)
